mission.title: Burning Both Ends
mission.description: Stop a trade of insecticide and flit gun parts between Zion and the Machines.

npc.say: The supplies need to go inside the safe -- every last one.

Why do corpses need to smell so bad, anyway? Who should I ask, God or the Machines? Hmm... When I put it that way, I think the Machines have become God.
Woah.

phase.briefing:
Inside sources have informed us of a deal that is going down today. The Machines and Zion plan to trade insecticide and flit gun parts. We -- and by "we" I mean you -- must prevent this transaction from taking place.
Break into this Machine base and access their network via a mainframe. To do this, you will need an access code. Remember this.
And one more thing: I don't doubt that you will run into opposition. If that happens, put a stop to them by making them dead. Capeesh?

enter.say: This doesn't sound so hard. Hit a mainframe, hit some guys in the head, and get out. Easy enough, right?
You're getting close. The mainframe should be in the next room. I'll...leave you to your fighting.

objective.text: Kill all of the Machine guards

done.say: That was the last hostile for this area. Don't worry, I'm sure you'll get your chance to smack down some more suckers at the next location.
That's the access code. Now, stick it into the mainframe.

objective.text: Put the access code into the mainframe

done.say:
I think it's funny that you're actually inside a massive computer, using a computer, and you still need an access code.
What? You don't think it's funny? Just... just run a search.

What the crap does "under the pale gray sky" mean? "Above the ocean of black?" That could be anywhere...
Whatever. I'll send this off to Flood.

phase.briefing:
Believe it or not, I have turned that silly little mainframe poetry into two solid leads. Am I good? Yes, I am.
The first location is not far from your current position, but move quickly. If you don't get there before the transaction is complete, there will be nothing left to steal. We can't have that, can we?

enter.say: At last, I feel like we're making progress. I'll keep tabs on you as best I can.

done.say: Okay, this is how we'll do it: first you give me the flit gun parts, and then I'll give you the red insecticide.
Screw that! You give me the insecticide, and then I'll give you the flit gun parts -- and don't try anything funny. Don't give me that white insecticide crap. I won't fall for it!
We don't have time to argue! Merovingian scum at 12 o'clock!

objective.text: Get the red insecticide from Dubiago's body
Get the flit gun parts from Snake's body

done.say: That package contains the flit gun parts we need. Don't lose it.

near.say: I'm getting a strong signal from that room. I think Dubiago and Snake hold your cargo. Maybe if you ask nice, they'll hand it over...

phase.briefing:
Progress is made and I am pleased. Things go well when I'm in a good mood. As for the next part of your assignment, an assembled flit gun shan't stay in the hands of the Machines.
The second location is already pointed out to you. Don't waste any time getting there, {player}.

enter.say: I have a bad feeling about this. I'm seeing some crazy code stream by... I think Zion and the Machines are onto us. Proceed with caution and a loaded weapon.

objective.text: Kill all of the Zion and Machine operatives

done.say: I think that was the last hostile signal. Nothing more to slaughter, friend.
I keep thinking that is the silliest looking gun I've ever seen. I'm reminded of its purpose and...it's still funny lookin'.
Another order of insecticide has been accounted for.

phase.briefing: Now that you have taken away their precious toys, we need the flit gun parts, the flit gun, and insecticide secured. Bring them to Fedchenko.

enter.say: Ahh... The calm after the storm. I always like this part. No surprises.

talk.say: The supplies need to go inside the safe -- every last one.

objective.text: Put the flit gun parts in the safe
Put the flit gun in the safe
Put the red insecticide in the safe
Put the second order of insecticide in the safe

complete.say: Now go... before I get hungry.

mission.finish:
The seriousness of the matter with our associate is becoming quite apparent. I fear that Zion and the Machines are proving to be far more deadly than they were before this silly little truce of theirs.
I am outlining the details of your next assignment. Your services will be called upon very soon.
